How much is a used Supreme Box Logo hoodie worth?

The Box Logo hoodie is the most valuable everyday Supreme item, and also the most faked. Most other Supreme clothing sells for much less.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The season is printed on the neck or wash tag (for example FW and the year). The box logo is a felt patch with embroidered letters. Other Supreme hoodies with a printed or small logo are a different, cheaper market.

What decides the price

  • Authenticity: fakes are very common. Without good photos of the tags and stitching, the price drops.
  • Season and colour: some seasons and colours are far more sought after.
  • Size: M and L sell best.
  • Condition: a clean, unfaded logo and no cracks or pills.

Check before you buy

  • Compare the tags, the logo and the stitching with verified examples.
  • Check the season on the tag matches the colourway.
  • Use an authentication service for expensive pieces.

Where it sells best

Sells on eBay and Vinted, and on resale platforms with authentication. Show the tags and logo close up.

Today's price

Prices for a used Supreme Box Logo hoodie change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Supreme Box Logo hoodie worth?

It depends on season, colour, size, condition and authenticity. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Supreme Box Logo hoodie" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

How can I tell if a Supreme Box Logo is fake?

Check the tags, the font, the logo patch and the stitching against verified photos from the same season. For expensive pieces, use an authentication service.

Is all Supreme clothing worth reselling?

No. Box Logo items and some collaborations keep their value; many other T-shirts and accessories sell for less than people expect.
